newsitem.title: USA: National Wireless declares special dividend.
newsitem.headline: National Wireless declares special dividend.

text.p: National Wireless Holdings Inc said Tuesday it declared a special cash dividend of $1.30 per share payable on October 2 to stockholders of record at the close of business on September 12.
In addition, National Wireless said it plans to buy back up to 15 percent of its shares of its common stock from time to time in the open market.

The company said that based on currently anticipated year end results, reflecting no sale of BellSouth Corp common stock received in the recent disposition of National Wireless' Florida wireless cable subsidiary, substantially all of the dividend is expected to be treated as a tax free return of capital to public stockholders.
